result.summary: The page is largely intact, but the bottom navigation bar is visually broken: the system gesture handle is drawn on top of the tab icons, and the tab bar is clipped at the bottom of the screen. No other clear defects were found.

issues.description: The system home-indicator/gesture bar overlaps the bottom navigation, striking through the search and orders tab icons. The tab bar also sits too low: icons are clipped at the screen edge and no labels are visible, which suggests the safe-area inset is not respected.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom safe-area padding (window insets) to the bottom navigation so the tab icons and labels sit fully above the system gesture handle, and make sure the bar's full height is visible.
